review.reviewer: Implementation owner (self-review against agent-dispatch, agent-radar, agent-integration, and agent-profiles contracts)
review.decision: Proceed with composer auxiliary-drawer handling, Antigravity annotation title resolution, pre-detach hook lifecycle ancestry, subagent isolation, and transcript/profile polish
review.notes: Covers 3 live-reproduced Antigravity UX regressions: 3-border background-task drawer false draft detection, bare 'agy' pane title and .pbtxt conversation title lookup, and missing hook launch-chain / 'auto' model / subagent / <SYSTEM_MESSAGE> / search_web handling.

evidence_limits: Unit and fixture tests exercise deterministic Go parsers, hook execution, radar assembly, and SGR composer captures; live tmux/menu-bar validation occurs after local installation.

cases.description: SplitInputRegion, DraftOfColored, and BoxEmpty select the upper prompt composer box when an auxiliary non-prompt task drawer box is rendered directly beneath it
cases.setup: Multi-border terminal captures modeled on Antigravity CLI with 1+ running background tasks below the '> ' composer (both empty composer and typed user draft).
cases.action: Call SplitInputRegion, DraftOfColored, and BoxEmpty on empty-composer and non-empty-composer captures with a lower background-task box.
cases.expected: Empty composer returns draft='' and BoxEmpty=true; typed composer returns exact user draft without task-drawer text and BoxEmpty=false.

cases.description: AgySessionTitle and SessionTitles('agy') decode protobuf textformat titles from $AGY_HOME/annotations/*.pbtxt safely
cases.setup: Synthetic $AGY_HOME/annotations directory containing ASCII, octal-escaped UTF-8 Chinese, escaped-quote, multiline, and malformed .pbtxt files plus path-traversal IDs.
cases.action: Call AgySessionTitle for individual IDs (including '../escape') and SessionTitles('agy').
cases.expected: Valid annotations return decoded single-line UTF-8 titles; unsafe IDs and malformed files return empty strings.

cases.description: Radar strips bare 'agy'/'antigravity' placeholder pane titles and populates bound tmux and native Antigravity rows from saved annotation titles
cases.setup: Injected tmux panes running agy (one bound to a resume record with an annotations/<id>.pbtxt title, one unbound with pane_title 'agy') and a native agy record.
cases.expected: Bound tmux pane reports Task equal to the saved annotation title; unbound tmux pane strips 'agy' to Task=''; native agy row carries its saved annotation title.

cases.description: Antigravity hooks classify pre-detach lifecycle events for launch-chain collection and ignore subagent callbacks carrying a distinct rootConversationId
cases.setup: Isolated HOME/TMUX state with a parent agy session and synthetic PreInvocation, PostToolUse, and subagent hook payloads.
cases.action: Run hook.Run for root PreInvocation/PostToolUse hooks and for a subagent hook where rootConversationId != conversationId.
cases.expected: Root PreInvocation/PostToolUse pass canonical UserPromptSubmit/Resumed lifecycle events to profile/launch observation; subagent hook emits '{}' on stdout and leaves parent resume/state/profile untouched.

cases.description: Antigravity participant profile ignores 'auto' router modelName in hooks while preserving concrete PLANNER_RESPONSE models and AGY_HOME scoping
cases.setup: Synthetic agy transcript recording PLANNER_RESPONSE model 'gemini-4-carbon-medium' and hook observation carrying modelName 'auto' vs explicit concrete modelName under isolated AGY_HOME.
cases.action: Evaluate HookFacts, Observe, ReadLogs, and Current for the agy session across two AGY_HOME roots.
cases.expected: Hook modelName 'auto' does not clobber 'gemini-4-carbon-medium'; concrete hook modelName is recorded; distinct AGY_HOME directories do not share profile snapshots.

cases.description: Antigravity transcript parser drops standalone <SYSTEM_MESSAGE> injections and normalizes search_web and workspace tools into Activity action facts
cases.setup: Synthetic agy transcript containing a <SYSTEM_MESSAGE>-only USER_INPUT, a mixed user prompt with trailing <SYSTEM_MESSAGE>, and PLANNER_RESPONSE tool calls including search_web and grep_search.
cases.action: Load turns with transcript.Load('agy', ...) and inspect prompts and tool Step Action/Operation/Detail fields.
cases.expected: Standalone <SYSTEM_MESSAGE> opens no turn; user prompt strips trailing system blocks; search_web sets Operation='web', Action='web_search', and query Detail.
